newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian air travel rose 12 pct in June - ISTAT.
newsitem.headline: Italian air travel rose 12 pct in June - ISTAT.

text.p: Italian air passenger traffic in June rose 12.0 percent to total 5.91 million passengers compared with the same month of 1995, national statistics institute ISTAT said on Tuesday.
It said international passenger traffic rose 9.5 percent to 2.84 million while domestic traffic rose 14.4 percent to 3.07 million.
In the second quarter of 1996, passenger movements rose 7.0 percent to 16.59 million compared with the same period of 1995.
The data cover arrivals and departures at Italian airports.
